meta.title: Test drive the LEPAS L8 in Pitești – book online
meta.description: Drive the new LEPAS L8: a 278 hp plug-in hybrid SUV with up to 1,040 km combined range. Free test drive at the LEPAS Pitești showroom. From €42,500 incl. VAT.

lepasL8.eyebrow: Official launch in Romania · Pitești showroom
lepasL8.title: Book a test drive in the new LEPAS L8
lepasL8.subtitle: A 278 hp plug-in hybrid SUV with up to 1,040 km combined range. Come and drive it in Pitești.
trust: We call you to book it
You pick the day and time

reasons.title: Leopard-inspired design
reasons.text: Flowing lines, “leopard-eye” headlights and full-width LED taillights. A presence that stands out.

reasons.title: An interior like a third space
reasons.text: Digital cockpit, velvety materials and generous room for the whole family.

reasons.title: Super Hybrid plug-in
reasons.text: Electric in town, carefree on long trips: up to 1,040 km on one tank and one charge.

reasons.title: Technology that helps
reasons.text: 360° view with transparent chassis and remote control from your phone.

lepasL8.offerText: Available in Essence and Elegance versions.

items.title: Fill in the form
items.text: Name, phone and e-mail – that's it.

items.title: We call to set a time
items.text: A LEPAS Pitești consultant contacts you to book it.

items.title: Come and drive
items.text: Bring your driving licence. We prepare the rest.

faq.q: How much does a test drive cost?
faq.a: Nothing. The test drive is free and comes with no obligation.

faq.q: What do I need to bring?
faq.a: A valid driving licence and an ID.
We agree on the day and time that suit you, over the phone.

faq.q: Can I also ask about financing or my current car?
faq.a: Yes. The consultant can walk you through financing options and value your car if you'd like to trade it in.

finalCta.title: Ready to drive it?
finalCta.text: Fill in the form and we'll call you.

meta.title: LEPAS L6 – pre-order at the launch price in Pitești
meta.description: The new LEPAS L6: a 279 hp compact plug-in hybrid SUV with up to 92 km electric and 1,058 km combined range (WLTP). Launch price €35,990 incl. VAT at LEPAS Pitești.

lepasL6.title: The new LEPAS L6, at the launch price
lepasL6.subtitle: A 279 hp compact plug-in hybrid SUV with up to 92 km electric and 1,058 km combined range. Ask LEPAS Pitești for the offer.
trust: We call you with all the details

reasons.title: Electric every day
reasons.text: Up to 92 km on electricity alone (WLTP) – enough for everyday city driving without petrol.

reasons.title: Carefree on long trips
reasons.text: Up to 1,058 km combined range (WLTP) on one tank and one charge.

reasons.title: 279 hp plug-in hybrid
reasons.text: A 1.5 turbo petrol engine backed by an electric system with an 18.4 kWh battery.

reasons.title: Compact format
reasons.text: About 4.5 m long with a 2.7 m wheelbase: easy to drive in town, with room for the family.

lepasL6.offerText: Elegance version. Price valid for pre-orders between 6 October and 30 November 2026, with a €1,000 deposit.

items.title: Fill in the form
items.text: Name, phone and e-mail – that's it.

items.title: We call you with the offer
items.text: A LEPAS Pitești consultant walks you through the launch offer and the pre-order steps.

items.title: You decide
items.text: If you like it, you reserve your car at the launch price. If not, it costs you nothing.

faq.q: How much is the LEPAS L6?
faq.a: The launch price is €35,990 incl. VAT, against a list price of €39,990 incl. VAT, for the Elegance version.

faq.q: Until when is the launch price valid?
faq.a: For pre-orders placed between 6 October and 30 November 2026.
A €1,000 deposit. The LEPAS Pitești consultant gives you all the details before you decide.

faq.q: Am I committing to anything by sending the form?
faq.a: No. The form is only a request for an offer – we call you, answer your questions and you decide.

faq.q: Can I also ask about financing or my current car?
faq.a: Yes. The consultant can walk you through financing options and value your car if you'd like to trade it in.

finalCta.title: Catch the launch price
finalCta.text: Fill in the form and we'll call you with the offer.
